summary: An Orchid-style chord instrument firmware: one hand plays roots while the other picks chord types, with voicing, a bass part, performance modes and a chord looper. A public beta.
features: Seven synth engines: FM6, Digitone-style FM TONE, VA, CZ-1, P5, WHEEL, GRAIN
Key Mode, Simple, Advanced and Free play styles, latch and secret chords
Strum, slop, arpeggio and harp modes; four bass behaviours
Looper with ten slots and five record modes
Three USB MIDI streams out, clock both ways; three-pair USB audio
All-synth, no samples; installers refuse to go over SLOOP
